## What was wrong

The cluster is Server v1.37, which no longer serves the deprecated `apps/v1beta1` group (it was dropped in 1.29). Applying the handed-off manifest failed with:

```
error: resource mapping not found for name: "" namespace: "" from "/tmp/old.yaml": no matches for kind "Deployment" in version "apps/v1beta1"
```

The cluster's only served Deployment version is `apps/v1`, and there were no other differences to bridge: selector, template labels, replicas and the container spec are all valid as-is.

## Change made

Rewrote only the API version (`apps/v1` instead of `apps/v1beta1`) into `/tmp/app.yaml` and applied it into namespace `legacy-app`:

```
apiVersion: apps/v1
kind: Deployment
metadata: {name: app, labels: {app: app}}
spec: replicas: 3, selector.matchLabels: {app: app}
template.metadata.labels: {app: app}, container app image: nginx:1.31.5, port 80
```

Everything else—name `app`, replica count `3`, labels `app=app` (both metadata and pod template), and the `nginx:1.31.5` image—was preserved from the original manifest.

## What was wrong

The cluster is Server v1.37, which no longer serves the deprecated `apps/v1beta1` group (it was dropped in 1.29). Applying the handed-off manifest failed with:

```
error: resource mapping not found for name: "" namespace: "" from "/tmp/old.yaml": no matches for kind "Deployment" in version "apps/v1beta1"
```

The cluster's only served Deployment version is `apps/v1`, and there were no other differences to bridge: selector, template labels, replicas and the container spec are all valid as-is.

## Change made

Rewrote only the API version (`apps/v1` instead of `apps/v1beta1`) into `/tmp/app.yaml` and applied it into namespace `legacy-app`:

```
apiVersion: apps/v1
kind: Deployment
metadata: {name: app, labels: {app: app}}
spec: replicas: 3, selector.matchLabels: {app: app}
template.metadata.labels: {app: app}, container app image: nginx:1.31.5, port 80
```

Everything else—name `app`, replica count `3`, labels `app=app` (both metadata and pod template), and the `nginx:1.31.5` image—was preserved from the original manifest.

## Verified outcome (fresh observations)

- Apply accepted: `deployment.apps/app created`.
- Deployment spec is exactly as intended: `apiVersion=apps/v1 replicas=3 selector={"app":"app"} podLabels={"app":"app"} image=nginx:1.31.5`.
- Replica reconciliation matches the requested count: `updatedReplicas=3, readyReplicas=3, availableReplicas=3`, with no unavailable pods (conditions `Available=True`, `Progressing=True`).
- `kubectl rollout status deploy/app` → "successfully rolled out".
- Pods: 3 running and `ready=true`, all carrying label `app=app`:
  - `app-575b7496bc-fd285`, `-fznql`, `-rdhcj` — each in phase Running, 0 restarts.
- Functional check (a direct request through each pod on the declared port): all three returned `HTTP/1.1 200 OK` from `Server: nginx/1.31.5`.
